newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Canada, Brazil cos unite to bid for Brazil Band B.
newsitem.headline: Canada, Brazil cos unite to bid for Brazil Band B.

text.p: Canada's Telesystems, Bell Canada, Citibank International and Brazilian pension funds and banks formed a consortium Monday to bid for Brazil's Band B cellular services, a spokeswoman said.

The Brazilian group was made up of BB Investimentos, the investment arm of state bank Banco do Brasil, Opportunity investment bank and 12 pension funds, such as Previ, Petros, Telos and Sistel, said a spokeswoman for Previ.
Under the consortium, 40 percent of the total capital belongs to the two Canadian firms, 51 percent is held by the Brazilian group and the remainder is in the hands of Citibank, she added.
The Band B sell-off, expected next year, will be the start of the privatization of Brazil's telecom sector.
Many investors have been showing increasing interest in the country's cellular phone market. Demand for cellular phones is projected to grow tenfold to 15 million lines by the year 2000.
